rootCause: Canonical cpfDB has 201 current tables and the Fresh install/schema manifest already installed exactly 201, but stale generated Vendor verify projections still required 202. This produced the same table_count false failure in MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and Local One-WAS DB preparation.
ownerAction: Executed the canonical cpf-tools/db/tools/sync-database-artifacts.ps1 pipeline so generator-owned source, install, verify, and aggregate projections are current in one dependency-ordered pass.
oracleRootCause: The installed DockerRoot Compose stayed stale because the canonical installer copied base runtime files only when the destination was absent; Oracle was recreated with retired healthcheck.sh even though current Workspace Compose correctly inherits image health.
oracleOwnerAction: The installer now always refreshes its non-secret base runtime projection from the current Workspace with Force while keeping secrets and persistent volumes outside the owned file list.
oracleLifecycleRootCause: The official Oracle SQL runner is invoked in-process and owns SQLPlus through System.Diagnostics.Process, so it does not set the caller's LASTEXITCODE automatic variable. Its redirected StandardInputEncoding also used a BOM-emitting UTF-8 instance, causing SQLPlus SP2-0734 on the first command.
oracleLifecycleOwnerAction: The parent initializer now checks the PowerShell success pipeline variable immediately after every official vendor runner call, and the SQLPlus process receives explicit BOM-free UTF-8 stdin. No automatic variable preset, error tolerance, or readiness bypass is used.
oracleDiagnosticOwnerAction: A SQLPlus pipe-write exception is retained while the runner waits for process termination and harvests both already-started asynchronous output streams; the final sanitized failure now contains transport and database diagnostics and remains fail-closed.
oracleCurrentSchemaRootCause: The Canonical vendor Source generator used the PostgreSQL-compatible NOT NULL DEFAULT order for Oracle Current Fresh schema projections. Oracle 26ai rejects that grammar with ORA-03076 even though generated/current already represented the valid DEFAULT NOT NULL contract.
oracleCurrentSchemaOwnerAction: The Canonical generator now renders Oracle DEFAULT before NOT NULL and the complete dependency-ordered DB synchronization regenerated Current source/install projections. The three Fresh inputs contain 0 invalid and 2,558 valid ordered defaults; all immutable migration checksum manifests report unchanged.
oracleCheckExpressionOwnerAction: All four Canonical hash-length checks now declare Oracle LENGTH vendor expressions. Both generated/current and lifecycle Source/install projections contain exactly four supported LENGTH calls and zero CHAR_LENGTH calls; immutable migration bytes remain unchanged.
oracleTimeTypeOwnerAction: The lifecycle Source generator now matches the Canonical current renderer by mapping Oracle TIME to VARCHAR2(15 CHAR). The two affected columns are current in Source/install and unsupported TIME column count is zero.
oracleOutputOwnerAction: SQLPlus disables normal feedback, successful non-verify execution no longer replays captured stdout, and failure diagnostics retain an explicitly marked sanitized 65,536-character tail with exit and transport state.
oracleForeignKeyOwnerAction: Both Canonical current renderers omit explicit Oracle RESTRICT/NO ACTION because they are the semantic default and unsupported syntax; CASCADE and SET NULL remain explicit. All five current Source/generated/install inputs contain zero invalid clauses.
oracleSeedOrderingOwnerAction: Both Oracle seed renderers emit Canonical values upserts as ordered per-row MERGE statements. The 64 ADM_MENU rows are idempotent individually, the first statement has no UNION ALL, and GATEWAY_DASHBOARD precedes GATEWAY_SERVERS in generated/current, Source and product-seed bundle.
oracleSeedSourceColumnOwnerAction: The five Gateway ADM seed updates now use the intended CURRENT_TIMESTAMP instead of referencing an updated_at value absent from their source projection. Both renderers fail closed for any VALUES(column) update reference not supplied by the Canonical statement columns.
oracleSeedConflictKeyOwnerAction: Nine redundant updates of conflict-key columns were removed from the Canonical seed model. Both renderers reject any recurrence uniformly instead of applying an Oracle-only filter.
oracleVerifyLineOwnerAction: Canonical product-seed key predicates render one deterministic predicate per physical line for every Vendor. The Oracle lifecycle contract scans every SQL line and rejects any line over SQLPlus's 4,999-character input limit.
artifactSyncGarbageOwnerAction: All Python artifact steps run with -B so renderer imports cannot create __pycache__ in the developer-facing Source tree. The one cache observed from the prior synchronization was removed immediately.
oracleSequenceVerifyOwnerAction: The three-Vendor Spring Batch Verify generator derives the common BAT_SB_ namespace from the exact expected names, counts exactly three objects inside that namespace, verifies every exact name, and rejects every retired name. Oracle identity ISEQ objects and unrelated future providers remain outside this Owner's count.
sideEffects: No immutable migration/checksum file changed. Non-count schema/install projection diffs are generator normalization of duplicate blank lines only. Docker Secret files and persistent volumes remain untouched.
